instructions: Only from the manufacturer's current data sheet / listing document; leave unknown fields null. response_type is REQUIRED for NFPA13-2019-DEV-ENVELOPE-1: enter it exactly as the document states it (no default is ever assumed); an approved Rule G must accept it or the design fails. Until a real listing exists, M2.2B designs run in rule_validation mode with a SYNTHETIC listing (TEST_ONLY response value) and are NOT product-specific designs.
